observations: The device-Present fallback produced flat menu content and CoJ PID 404 acquired scene focus on the first scene submit.
Sense pointer/click interaction and Create re-anchor were exercised successfully in flat-theater mode.
The user saw a doubled image because this artifact uploaded the same centered source rectangle to both runtime-eye textures without finite-distance eye placement.
The process crashed during level load before any flat-theater to native-stereo transition; the crash is consistent with a failed D3D resource lock but does not by itself prove the cause.

The artifact's flat capture ring retained D3DPOOL_DEFAULT resources across menu/loading. Current source removes that Reset hazard with immediate readback and proves Reset/post-Reset recapture at host level.
SteamVR dashboard visibility changed while CoJ still held scene focus; the project PS VR2 Sense binding defines no dashboard/system action.
